events.title: Dartmouth AI workshop convenes
events.titleZh: 达特茅斯人工智能研讨会召开
events.summary: The Dartmouth workshop helped name artificial intelligence as a research program and gathered early researchers around machine reasoning, learning, and symbolic problem solving.
events.summaryZh: 达特茅斯研讨会帮助把“人工智能”命名为一个研究计划，并把早期研究者聚集到机器推理、学习和符号问题求解周围。
sourceNotes: Dartmouth workshop is widely treated as an origin point for AI as a named field.
events.eventIntro: In the summer of 1956, a small group of mathematicians and computer scientists met at Dartmouth College to explore whether aspects of intelligence could be described precisely enough for machines to simulate them.
events.eventIntroZh: 1956 年夏天，一小群数学家和计算机科学家在达特茅斯学院聚会，探讨智能的某些方面是否可以被精确定义到足以让机器模拟。
events.whyMatters: The meeting did not create AI all at once, but it gave the field a name, a research agenda, and a network of people who would shape symbolic AI, search, theorem proving, and early machine learning.
events.whyMattersZh: 这次会议并没有一夜之间创造人工智能，但它给这个领域提供了名称、研究议程和一批人际网络，后来影响了符号 AI、搜索、定理证明和早期机器学习。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the Symbolic AI and early laboratories phase because it turned scattered work in logic, cybernetics, computation, and psychology into a recognizable AI research community.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“符号 AI 与早期实验室”阶段，因为它把逻辑、控制论、计算和心理学中的分散工作，转化为一个可识别的 AI 研究共同体。
events.connectionHint: It connects naturally to later expert systems, because early AI inherited the belief that intelligence could be represented as symbols, rules, and explicit problem-solving procedures.
events.connectionHintZh: 它自然连接到后来的专家系统，因为早期 AI 继承了一种信念：智能可以被表示为符号、规则和明确的问题求解过程。
events.imageAlt: Dartmouth College campus, where the 1956 artificial intelligence workshop convened.
events.imageCaption: Dartmouth College gives the AI workshop a concrete institutional setting rather than treating it as an abstract origin myth.
events.imageCaptionZh: 达特茅斯学院让 1956 年 AI 研讨会有了具体制度地点，而不是只作为抽象的起源神话。

events.title: AlexNet wins ImageNet
events.summary: AlexNet's ImageNet victory made deep convolutional neural networks central to modern computer vision and helped trigger the deep learning wave.
events.summaryZh: AlexNet 在 ImageNet 上的胜利让深度卷积神经网络成为现代计算机视觉的核心，并推动了深度学习浪潮。
sourceNotes: ImageNet 2012 is a standard turning point in deep learning histories.
events.eventIntro: In 2012, AlexNet dramatically outperformed other ImageNet competitors by using a deep convolutional network trained with GPUs, large labeled image data, and practical engineering tricks.
events.eventIntroZh: 2012 年，AlexNet 使用 GPU 训练的深度卷积网络、大规模标注图像数据和实用工程技巧，在 ImageNet 竞赛中显著超越其他方法。
events.whyMatters: Its success changed what many researchers believed neural networks could do. Deep learning moved from a specialized approach into the center of computer vision, speech, translation, and later generative AI.
events.whyMattersZh: 它改变了许多研究者对神经网络能力的判断。深度学习从一种较专门的方法，进入计算机视觉、语音、翻译以及后来的生成式 AI 的中心。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the Deep learning phase because it showed that data, GPUs, and neural architectures could outperform hand-designed feature pipelines at scale.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“深度学习”阶段，因为它证明数据、GPU 和神经网络结构可以在规模化条件下超越手工设计的特征流程。
events.connectionHint: It also links to semiconductor and hardware history: modern AI depended not just on algorithms, but on GPU acceleration and the economics of large-scale computation.
events.connectionHintZh: 它也连接到半导体和硬件史：现代 AI 不只是算法史，也依赖 GPU 加速和大规模计算的经济条件。
events.imageAlt: Diagram of convolutional neural network filtering used to explain the kind of vision architecture AlexNet popularized.
events.imageCaption: Convolutional networks became the visual-recognition architecture associated with AlexNet's ImageNet breakthrough.
events.imageCaptionZh: 卷积网络成为与 AlexNet 的 ImageNet 突破相关联的视觉识别架构。

events.title: Transformer paper published
events.summary: The transformer architecture used attention to reshape language modeling and became a foundation for large-scale generative AI systems.
events.summaryZh: Transformer 架构用注意力机制重塑语言建模，并成为大规模生成式 AI 系统的基础。
sourceNotes: The 2017 paper 'Attention Is All You Need' is the standard reference for transformers.
events.eventIntro: In 2017, researchers introduced the transformer architecture in the paper 'Attention Is All You Need.' It replaced many recurrent sequence-processing assumptions with attention-based layers that scaled well on modern hardware.
events.eventIntroZh: 2017 年，研究者在《Attention Is All You Need》论文中提出 Transformer 架构。它用基于注意力的层替代了许多循环序列处理假设，并能很好地在现代硬件上扩展。
events.whyMatters: Transformers became the core architecture behind many large language models and later multimodal foundation models. They changed AI from narrow task systems toward general-purpose pretrained models.
events.whyMattersZh: Transformer 成为许多大型语言模型以及后来的多模态基础模型的核心架构。它推动 AI 从狭窄任务系统转向通用预训练模型。
events.phaseRelation: This event defines the Transformers and foundation models phase because it provided the architectural pattern that made large-scale pretraining unusually productive.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它定义了“Transformer 与基础模型”阶段，因为它提供了让大规模预训练异常有效的架构模式。
events.connectionHint: It connects AI to software infrastructure, because transformers required new training pipelines, distributed systems, model serving, and data engineering practices.
events.connectionHintZh: 它把 AI 连接到软件基础设施，因为 Transformer 需要新的训练流水线、分布式系统、模型服务和数据工程实践。
events.imageAlt: Diagram of the transformer architecture associated with attention-based sequence modeling.
events.imageCaption: Transformer diagrams make visible the attention-based architecture that became a foundation for modern language models.
events.imageCaptionZh: Transformer 架构图让基于注意力机制的结构可见，而这种结构成为现代语言模型的基础。

events.title: ChatGPT released publicly
events.summary: ChatGPT made conversational generative AI visible to a mass public and changed expectations about software, search, writing, work, and education.
events.summaryZh: ChatGPT 让对话式生成 AI 进入大众视野，并改变了人们对软件、搜索、写作、工作和教育的期待。
sourceNotes: ChatGPT's public launch is widely treated as a mass adoption moment for generative AI.
events.eventIntro: OpenAI released ChatGPT to the public in November 2022. The product wrapped a large language model in an accessible chat interface, letting non-specialists ask questions, draft text, write code, and experiment directly.
events.eventIntroZh: OpenAI 于 2022 年 11 月向公众发布 ChatGPT。这个产品把大型语言模型包装在易用的聊天界面中，让非专业用户也能提问、写作、写代码和直接实验。
events.whyMatters: Its impact came from usability as much as model capability. ChatGPT turned foundation models from a research and platform technology into an everyday interface that organizations, schools, workers, and developers had to respond to.
events.whyMattersZh: 它的影响不仅来自模型能力，也来自可用性。ChatGPT 把基础模型从研究和平台技术变成日常界面，迫使组织、学校、劳动者和开发者都作出回应。
events.phaseRelation: This event belongs to the Generative AI products phase because it marked the moment when model capability, product design, cloud delivery, and public adoption converged.
events.phaseRelationZh: 它属于“生成式 AI 产品”阶段，因为它标志着模型能力、产品设计、云端交付和公众采用汇合的时刻。
events.connectionHint: It connects to networks, cloud platforms, software engineering, and education because generative AI became a service layer used through browsers, APIs, IDEs, and workplace tools.
events.connectionHintZh: 它连接到网络、云平台、软件工程和教育，因为生成式 AI 成为通过浏览器、API、IDE 和办公工具使用的服务层。
events.imageAlt: ChatGPT logo representing the public release of OpenAI's conversational generative AI product.
events.imageCaption: The ChatGPT mark represents the product layer that made large language models visible to a mass public.
events.imageCaptionZh: ChatGPT 标识代表让大型语言模型进入大众视野的产品层。
